info.name: Plerion API Documentation Alerts Findings API

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter findings based on Plerion Resource Names (prn) or ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of ids.

params.name: detectionIds
params.description: Filter findings based on Plerion Detection IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list of detection ids.

params.name: regions
params.description: Filter findings based on Provider regions. Accepts a comma-separated list of regions.

params.name: assetIds
params.description: Filter findings based on Asset Plerion Resource Names (prn) or asset ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of asset ids.

params.name: integrationIds
params.description: Filter findings based on Plerion integration ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of integration ids.

params.name: assetGroupIds
params.description: Filter findings based on asset group ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of asset group ids.

params.name: environmentIds
params.description:
Filter findings on the environment. This parameter accepts any combination of environment name or environment IDs (UUIDs) in a comma-separated list.

**Supported environment names:**
- `production` - Production environment
- `non-production` - Non-production environment

params.name: severityLevels
params.description: Filter findings based on severity levels. Accepts a comma-separated list of severity levels.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filter findings based on statuses. Accepts a comma-separated list of statuses.

params.name: slaStatuses
params.description: Filter findings based on SLA status. Only applies to FAILED findings that are tracked against an SLA. Accepts a comma-separated list of SLA statuses: breached (past the resolution deadline), nearBreach (inside the warning window but not yet breached), and withinSla (still ahead of the warning window).

params.name: resourceTypes
params.description: Filter findings based on provider resource types. Accepts a comma-separated list of resource types.

params.name: providers
params.description: Filter findings based on provider. Accepts a comma-separated list of providers.

params.name: services
params.description: Filter findings based on cloud provider services. Accepts a comma-separated list of service names. Each service can be specified either by its name alone (e.g., `S3`, `Lambda`, `EC2`) or prefixed with its provider in the format `Provider::Service` (e.g., `AWS::S3`, `GCP::Compute`, `Azure::VirtualMachine`).

params.name: isExempted
params.description: Filter findings based on whether the finding is exempted. Accepts `true` or `false`.

params.name: firstObservedAtStart
params.description:
Start of the date range for filtering findings based on the first observed time. 
Specify the start of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. 
If `firstObservedAtStart` is provided and `firstObservedAtEnd` is omitted, 
results will include findings from this date to the present.
Supported formats include:
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00Z`)
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: firstObservedAtEnd
params.description:
End of the date range for filtering findings based on the first observed time. 
Specify the end of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. 
If `firstObservedAtEnd` is provided and `firstObservedAtStart` is omitted, 
results will include findings up to this date.
Supported formats include:
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00Z`)
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Order the list by supported field

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order of the list. The parameter sortBy has to be provided to use sortOrder. If sortOrder is not provided the default order is `ASC`

params.name: perPage
params.description: Specify the batch size of the list. Used for pagination

params.name: cursor
params.description: Get the next batch of findings. Used for pagination. When cursor is provided, the response will not include total count.

items.docs:
Use the list findings API to filter findings across the tenant with many
options from Provider, Service, Detection, Severity, Integration, etc. By
default all `PASSED` and `FAILED` findings are returned. To list
only failed findings filter by `statuses=FAILED`

Date range filtering is supported using the `firstObservedAtStart` and `firstObservedAtEnd` parameters:
